analysis.title: Data Engineer
analysis.fit_rationale: Strong alignment with core data engineering requirements: extensive Python and SQL expertise, ETL pipeline development, AWS lakehouse project experience, and Agile/Jira familiarity. Gaps in formal DoD/government experience and limited production AWS data pipeline exposure.
strengths: Expert-level Python and SQL/Oracle with extensive ETL design and optimization experience
Built Python/Pandas ETL for telemetry from 6,000+ endpoints with validation and cleansing
Designed AWS S3/Glue/Athena/Bedrock lakehouse project with Text-to-SQL agent and Parquet optimization
Experience with Jira, Git, and Agile methodologies from current role
Strong data quality, testing, and pipeline monitoring skills
Proven ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions
gaps: No explicit Department of Defense or government environment experience
AWS experience is project-based, not professional production deployment
Limited exposure to AWS Lambda and Glue in production settings
Data engineering experience is more infrastructure/capacity-focused than pure data pipeline development
tailoring_plan: Emphasize Python/SQL ETL expertise and AWS lakehouse project. Frame capacity forecasting as data pipeline work. Highlight Agile/Jira experience. Address government/DoD gap by emphasizing security and compliance awareness from enterprise environments. Consider obtaining AWS certification to offset lack of formal credential.
